object: All connected components of the elementary Gamma_K including isolated K-facets, their abstract ancestry, exact strict/closed cuts and point unions.

theorem.births: Exactly Gabriel facets of cardinal K, born at their minimum enclosing ball squared radius; no coface is incident at that same birth level on regular input.
theorem.no_coface_birth: Every regular coface has at least two strict pre-existing facets whose union is its entire point set.
theorem.point_conservation: Every full post-batch component formed by cofaces covers exactly the union of its strict parents. Full one-parent continuations have zero new points.
theorem.merges: A multi-parent batch contains a Gabriel coface of cardinal K+1; pure non-Gabriel groups have a single strict apex by confluence.
theorem.window: For requested orders1..M use rank cutoff min(M+1,n). All Gabriel K-facet births are within rank K. Irregular above-window blocks are inert via saturated strict connectivity.
theorem.terminal_order: K=n has the single Gabriel facet X born at beta(X), no coface, and one persistent full leaf. It is not the empty reduced hierarchy.
theorem.vertical: For K>=2, a source leaf F is a Gabriel coface at orderK-1. Its target is the lower component after the entire equal-level closed batch; subsequent maps follow horizontal normalization and naturality.
theorem.certificate: Leaf IDs with K PointIds and exact birth levels, plus merge IDs, strict parent sets and exact levels, suffice for full abstract ancestry and point unions. No continuation point deltas required.
